```artifact
<Finite State Machines / Statecharts Representation>

// States
[Initial, Idle, ProcessingChange, AssociatedWithDeveloper, ScalingUp, InstallationMode, ErrorState]

// Mode-switching behavior
(Idle -> ProcessingChange on "startChangeProcess")
(ProcessingChange -> AssociatedWithDeveloper on "associateChange")
(AssociatedWithDeveloper -> ScalingUp on "scaleUp")
(ScalingUp -> InstallationMode on "startInstallation")
(InstallationMode -> ErrorState on "errorDuringInstallation")
(InstallationMode -> Idle on "installationComplete")
(ErrorState -> Idle on "errorResolved")

// Events
on startChangeProcess
on associateChange
on scaleUp
on startInstallation
on installationComplete
on errorDuringInstallation
on errorResolved

// Guards
(startChangeProcess -> true)
(associateChange -> true)
(scaleUp -> true)
(installationComplete -> true)
(errorDuringInstallation -> false)
(errorResolved -> true)

// Transitions
(true -> ProcessingChange)
(false -> Idle)
(true -> AssociatedWithDeveloper)
(true -> ScalingUp)
(true -> InstallationMode)
(false -> ErrorState)
(true -> Idle)
(true -> ErrorState)
(true -> installationComplete)
(false -> Idle)
(true -> errorResolved)
(false -> Idle)

// Test Cases
[
  {"id": "TC-001", "title": "Verify initial state", "req_ids": ["REQ011", "REQ012", "REQ013", "REQ014"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": [], "inputs": {"name": "startChangeProcess": true}, "steps": ["Start change process", "Enter ProcessingChange state"], "expected": ["ProcessingChange state reached"]},
  {"id": "TC-002", "title": "Verify handling of requirement change", "req_ids": ["REQ012", "REQ013"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": [], "inputs": {"name": "associateChange": true}, "steps": ["Associate change with developer", "Enter AssociatedWithDeveloper state"], "expected": ["AssociatedWithDeveloper state reached"]},
  {"id": "TC-003", "title": "Verify scalability", "req_ids": ["REQ013", "REQ014"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": [], "inputs": {"name": "scaleUp": true}, "steps": ["Initiate scaling up", "Enter ScalingUp state"], "expected": ["ScalingUp state reached"]},
  {"id": "TC-004", "title": "Verify lightweight installation method", "req_ids": ["REQ015"], "kind": "positive", "preconditions": [], "inputs": {"name": "startInstallation": true}, "steps": ["Begin installation", "Enter InstallationMode state"], "expected": ["InstallationMode state reached"]},
  {"id": "TC-005", "title": "Verify error handling during installation", "req_ids": ["REQ015"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": [], "inputs": {"name": "errorDuringInstallation": true}, "steps": ["Simulate installation error", "Enter ErrorState"], "expected": ["ErrorState reached"]},
  {"id": "TC-006", "title": "Verify error resolution", "req_ids": ["REQ015"], "kind": "negative", "preconditions": [], "inputs": {"name": "errorResolved": true}, "steps": ["Resolve installation error", "Enter Idle state"], "expected": ["Idle state reached"]}
]
```
